definition: Reverso is a company specialized in AI-based language tools, translation aids, and language services.
details: These include online translation based on neural machine translation (NMT), contextual dictionaries, online bilingual concordances, definition dictionaries, grammar and spell checking and conjugation tools.

explainer.lead: Reverso is a company offering AI-based language tools, translation aids, and language services. It matters as a widely used consumer and professional suite for translation and language learning.

tiers.eli5: It is a set of online tools that help you translate text and understand how words are used in real sentences.
tiers.practitioner: Users lean on its neural machine translation and contextual dictionaries for translation and concordance lookups. A pitfall is relying on machine output without checking context-sensitive phrases where translations vary by usage.
tiers.paperLevel: A suite of language services including NMT-based translation, contextual dictionaries, bilingual concordances, definition dictionaries, grammar and spell checking, and conjugation; NMT quality is bounded by training data and domain coverage.

explainer.example: A translator looks up a phrase to see it in several bilingual example sentences, then checks the suggested translation against those concordances before committing.
